workflow.name: Expense report review (sample)
workflow.description: Sample workflow seeded so the tutor can be tried before any expert session is recorded. A finance reviewer checks submitted expense reports before they are paid.

fields.name: days_since_expense
fields.description: days between the expense and the report being submitted

fields.name: attendees
fields.description: people present, for meals and entertainment

fields.name: note
fields.description: reviewer's note to the employee, empty if none

summary: Hand-written sample Work Map: three judgment calls a senior reviewer makes on expense reports.

skills.title: Hold expenses over $75 that have no receipt

action.detail: Put the report on hold and ask the employee for the receipt

skills.expert_explanation: Anything over seventy-five needs a receipt. If I approve it without one, audit kicks it back months later and it's a mess to chase.

guardrail.description: Expenses over $75 without a receipt can't be approved

skills.title: Return meals that don't list attendees

action.detail: Return the report asking who attended

skills.expert_explanation: A meal is only reimbursable if we know who was there. I send it back asking for names rather than guessing.

guardrail.description: Meals without attendees go back to the employee with a note

skills.title: Tag expenses submitted more than 60 days late

action.detail: Add the late_submission tag so it routes to the manager

skills.expert_explanation: Anything older than two months needs the manager to sign off. Tagging it late routes it to them automatically.

guardrail.description: Late submissions must be tagged for manager sign-off
